SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.product_name, oi.unit_price, oi.quantity, oi.total_amount, oi.created_at, oi.updated_at
FROM shop_order_item oi
INNER JOIN shop_order o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} AND o.order_id = #{orderId}
ORDER BY oi.order_item_id ASC

SELECT address_name AS "addressName", recipient_name AS "recipientName", recipient_phone AS "recipientPhone", zipcode, address, address_detail AS "addressDetail" FROM member_address WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND address_id = #{addressId}

SELECT p.product_name AS "productName", pp.price_per_kg AS "pricePerKg" FROM product p JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT price_per_kg FROM product_price WHERE product_id = p.product_id AND use_yn = 'Y' AND base_date <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY base_date DESC, price_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) pp ON TRUE WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} AND p.use_yn = 'Y'

INSERT INTO shop_order ( order_no, member_id, address_id, address_name, order_type, payment_type, order_status, payment_status, orderer_name, orderer_phone, orderer_email, total_amount, recipient_name, recipient_phone, zipcode, address, address_detail, delivery_message ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{memberId}, #{addressId}, #{addressName}, 'MEMBER', #{paymentType}, 'PENDING', 'UNPAID', #{ordererName}, #{ordererPhone}, #{ordererEmail}, #{totalAmount}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{zipcode}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{deliveryMessage} ) RETURNING order_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shop_order_item ( order_id, product_id, product_name, weight_gram, unit_price, quantity ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{weightGram}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity} )

SELECT product_id AS "productId", weight_gram AS "weightGram", quantity FROM shop_order_item WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY order_item_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop_payment WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND payment_status = 'COMPLETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE product_stock SET remaining_weight_kg = remaining_weight_kg + #{weightKg}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND #{weightKg} > 0
